lines.say: Cell theory has three parts. First, all living things are made of cells.
Second, the cell is the basic unit of structure and function.
Third, all cells come from pre-existing cells, by cell division.

draw.alt: One cell divides into two new cells

lines.say: That rules out spontaneous generation, life appearing from non-living matter.
Cells are measured in micrometres. One millimetre is a thousand micrometres.
Every cell has four things: plasma membrane, cytosol, ribosomes and DNA.
Membrane, Cytosol, Ribosomes, DNA. My Cat Really Dances.
Beyond that, cells split into two big groups.
A prokaryote is like a studio flat. Its DNA sits in the nucleoid, with no walls around it.

draw.alt: Prokaryotic cell with circular DNA in a nucleoid, plasmid and ribosomes

lines.say: Bacteria and archaea are prokaryotes. One circular chromosome, often with plasmids.
A eukaryote is like a house with rooms. The DNA is locked in a nucleus.

draw.alt: Eukaryotic cell with a membrane-bound nucleus and mitochondria added

lines.say: Eukaryotes have membrane-bound organelles and linear DNA in several chromosomes.
Pro equals no, eu equals do. Prokaryotes have no nucleus.
Plant cells have three Cs that animal cells lack.
A cellulose cell wall for support, because plants have no skeleton.
Chloroplasts for photosynthesis, and a big central vacuole to keep the cell firm.
A wall alone does not prove a plant cell. Bacteria and fungi have walls too.
Everything enters and leaves through the membrane, the surface area.
As a cell grows, volume grows faster than surface area.
Watch the ratio. A 1 centimetre cube has six to one. A 2 centimetre cube has three to one.

draw.alt: Cubes of side 1, 2 and 4 with SA to V ratios 6, 3 and 1.5 to 1

items.text: double the side, halve the ratio

lines.say: A bigger cell has more surface, but a smaller ratio. Supply can't keep up.
Flattening helps. Same 8 cubic centimetres, but the flat block has five to one.
So cells stay small, flatten out, or grow microvilli.
Prokaryotes do have DNA and ribosomes. They just lack a nucleus.
Not all plant cells have chloroplasts. Root cells usually don't.
Don't mix units. Keep centimetres squared with centimetres cubed.
All cells come from pre-existing cells.
No nucleus means prokaryote. Name the feature that proves it.
Compare in matched pairs, using whereas.
Small cells exchange faster, like crushed ice melting faster than a block.
